title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: A roadmap for SRE careers: Linux, distributed systems, observability, SLOs, incident response, automation, capacity, and reliability projects.

tree.name: Systems and Reliability Foundations
tree.description: Build a base in Linux, networking, cloud, containers, distributed systems, failure modes, and operational thinking.

resources.title: What is Site Reliability Engineering? (Hitesh Choudhary)

children.name: Linux, Networking, and Cloud
children.description: Use Linux services, DNS, TLS, load balancers, containers, Kubernetes basics, and cloud infrastructure.

children.name: Distributed Systems Basics
children.description: Understand latency, retries, timeouts, queues, caches, replication, consistency, backpressure, and partial failure.

tree.name: Observability and SLOs
tree.description: Measure reliability with metrics, logs, traces, service level indicators, objectives, alerts, and dashboards.

children.name: Metrics, Logs, and Traces
children.description: Instrument services, build dashboards, trace requests, write useful alerts, and avoid alert fatigue.

children.name: SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets
children.description: Define user-centered reliability targets, track error budgets, and connect reliability to product decisions.

children.name: Practice: SLO Alert Review
children.description: Review noisy alerts, define SLIs/SLOs, tune thresholds, and document an incident response path.

tree.name: Incident Response and Automation
tree.description: Reduce toil through automation and respond to incidents with calm, structured, blameless operations.

children.name: Incident Management
children.description: Run incident roles, comms, escalation, mitigation, timelines, status updates, postmortems, and follow-up actions.

children.name: Toil Reduction and Automation
children.description: Automate repetitive ops work with scripts, runbooks, CI/CD checks, self-healing tasks, and safe deploy tooling.

tree.name: Capacity, Resilience, and Portfolio
tree.description: Practice reliability engineering through load tests, chaos experiments, capacity plans, and clear operational docs.

children.name: Load Testing and Resilience
children.description: Run load tests, define thresholds, test failover, practice game days, and plan capacity for peak traffic.

children.name: Project: Observable Reliable Service
children.description: Deploy a service with SLOs, Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, alerts, load tests, incident runbooks, and postmortem template.
